srd_id 0.1.2: flat placeholder prices for family items; see each item's cost_note; needs a decision

meta.srd_id_note: 0.1.3: the four header items no longer carry cost_cp (no flat placeholder; price keys off the chosen variant srd_id; needs_variant_choice stays). 0.1.2: every items.* entry now has srd_id (stable kebab-case SRD id from DCC Lore tables/item-reskins.json, schema item-reskins/0.1.0; built from each entry's chargen_keys). Existing item keys (snake_case) are unchanged and still used by packages/choices; srd_id is what the sheet stores and what prices/mechanics key off, never a display name. Four items are choice slots whose srd_id is a generic HEADER id (holy-symbol, gaming-set, musical-instrument, artisans-tools): they carry srd_id_kind='header', needs_variant_choice=true and srd_variant_ids; /create must make the player pick a variant and the sheet must store the variant srd_id (headers are never priced). Price fixes: arcane_focus_staff and druidic_focus_staff 20 cp -> 500 cp (SRD 5.2.1 Arcane Focus Staff / Druidic Focus Wooden staff 5 gp). Spellbook 50 gp kept (SRD 5.1 gear table; not in SRD 5.2.1 tables).
meta.roll_method_note: Current 0.1.6 (ability_methods added in 0.1.4; text unchanged since): Roll = three arrays of 4d6dl1, keep ONE with total above 72 (keep_min_total 73), no upper limit, reroll all three if none qualifies, every die logged; decision 024). No other table changed.
changelog: 0.1.7 (2026-10-07): mastery options = every weapon the class may master (2024); Druid Magician / Cleric Thaumaturge +1 cantrip (spells.bonus_cantrips); Ranger Hunter's Mark always prepared (not a pick); Explorer's, Dungeoneer's, Entertainer's, Burglar's Pack contents = SRD 5.2.

ability_methods.note: Current 0.1.6 (decision 024, spec v0.1.10; Roll added in 0.1.4): S8 methods. Standard array and point buy are unchanged (data in point_buy and standard_array). Roll is switched by the session setting create.allow_roll (default true). Background increases (+2/+1 or +1/+1/+1) are added after assignment under every method; no score above 20.

Mage Hand.effect: A ghostly hand that carries light things at range.

Mending.effect: Repair a single break or tear.

Message.effect: Whisper to a creature within sight; only they hear.

Armor of Agathys.effect: Temporary HP; attackers take cold damage.

Bane.effect: Enemies subtract a d4 from attacks and saves.

Burning Hands.effect: Cone of fire from your hands.

Charm Person.effect: A humanoid regards you as a friendly acquaintance.

Protection from Evil and Good.effect: Ward against aberrations, celestials, fiends, undead and more.
